description.en: The Gemini macOS app's own channel: gRPC to the Robin edge, the app's model picker (Flash / Pro / Argon / Flash-Lite), and its quota verb. The plugin speaks the app's private protobuf schema directly.
description.zh: Gemini macOS App 自带通道：走 Robin 边缘的 gRPC、App 同款模型选择器（Flash / Pro / Argon / Flash-Lite）与配额查询。插件直接说 App 的私有 protobuf 协议。

docs.en: Reuses the Gemini desktop app's OAuth client and Robin gRPC surface. Paste a Google refresh token carrying auth/gemini, auth/assistant and auth/client_channel; the app's own client id is a confidential client, so the plugin cannot run the authorization-code step itself.
docs.zh: 复用 Gemini 桌面 App 的 OAuth 客户端与 Robin gRPC 通道。粘贴一个带 auth/gemini、auth/assistant、auth/client_channel 三个 scope 的 Google refresh token；App 自己的 client id 是机密客户端，插件无法自行完成授权码交换。

description.en: Paste a Google OAuth refresh token for an account that has signed in to the Gemini desktop app. It needs the auth/gemini, auth/assistant and auth/client_channel scopes. The plugin exchanges it for access tokens and refreshes them automatically; nothing else is needed.
description.zh: 粘贴一个已经登录过 Gemini 桌面 App 的 Google OAuth refresh token，需要含 auth/gemini、auth/assistant、auth/client_channel 三个 scope。插件会用它换取 access token 并自动续期，其余无需配置。

help.en: A Google OAuth refresh token. Mint one with the Gemini app's scopes; the plugin never sees your password.
help.zh: Google OAuth refresh token。需携带 Gemini App 的 scope；插件不会接触你的密码。
